epochs[].sats[].cn0_effective_dbhz.note: carrier-to-noise-density ratio under the interference, from the anti-jam equation with the despreading processing gain

epochs[].sats[].cn0_nominal_dbhz.note: un-jammed carrier-to-noise-density ratio: received signal power plus receive-antenna gain minus the thermal noise density

epochs[].sats[].el_deg.note: satellite elevation above the receiver's local horizon

epochs[].sats[].js_db.note: jammer-to-signal power ratio at the receiver antenna output for this satellite's link; negative infinity (null) with no jammer

epochs[].sats[].prn.note: zero-based index of the satellite within the configured constellation, carried as its pseudo-random-noise code number

epochs[].t.note: epoch time since the start of the run: the grid index times time.step_s

epochs[].tracking.note: visible satellites whose effective C/N0 stays at or above the tracking-loss threshold — locked or degraded, but not lost

epochs[].visible.note: satellites above the elevation mask at this epoch

fom.availability_nominal.note: fraction of epochs at which at least four satellites are geometrically visible — the clean-sky ceiling for this geometry

fom.availability_under_jamming.note: fraction of epochs at which at least four satellites are still tracking under the jammer

fom.mean_js_db.note: mean jammer-to-signal power ratio over every visible-satellite sample; not-a-number (so null once serialised) with no jammer

fom.min_tracking.note: fewest satellites still tracking at any epoch of the run

seed.note: scenario random seed, echoed back; the interference chain is deterministic and draws no random numbers

figure_tiers.legend: VALIDATED: checked against an independent external oracle. MODELLED: first-principles or published-formula model, internally tested, with no external oracle to a stated tolerance. applicable=false: the figure is emitted for continuity but does not answer a question this scenario asks
figure_tiers.source: src/verification.rs (the verification matrix), read through src/fom_label.rs
